comparisons.interpretation: Gray specifies public-housing investment and Faircloth repeal. Rogers' current housing-and-childcare card emphasizes loan/grant programs and tax credits. These priorities can coexist; no opposition to public housing is inferred, and Rogers' pre-primary text version is unverified.

Both support expanding affordable housing supply. Gray specifies Faircloth Amendment repeal and public-housing investment; Herrera proposes a National Housing Emergency to accelerate construction. The comparison does not imply disagreement on other housing policies.

Both advocate truly affordable housing. Gray names public-housing investment and repeal of the Faircloth Amendment; Miller names tax incentives for builders. These are different mechanisms that could coexist, not proof that either rejects the other's proposal.
